faq.label: FAQ
faq.title: Business FAQ
faq.subtitle: Common questions from companies evaluating Porterchain.

contract.question: Do I need a contract?
contract.answer: No long-term contract is required to get started. Enterprise agreements with custom terms are available for high-volume accounts.

recurring.question: Can I schedule recurring pickups?
recurring.answer: Yes. Recurring routes can be configured daily, weekly, or on custom schedules through your merchant dashboard or with your account manager.

csv.question: Can I upload CSV files?
csv.answer: Yes. Bulk order upload via CSV is available on all business accounts. Templates and API documentation are provided during onboarding.

erp.question: Do you integrate with ERP systems?
erp.answer: We integrate with major ERP and inventory platforms via REST API. Our team assists with custom integrations during enterprise onboarding.

api.question: Can I use the API?
api.answer: Yes. Full REST API access is available for order creation, tracking, and reporting. Documentation is provided to all business accounts.

vehicles.question: What vehicles are available?
vehicles.answer: Sedan, SUV, Pickup, Cargo Van, High Roof Van, 16 ft Box Truck, and 20 ft Box Truck. All require a standard Ontario G Licence.

pricing.question: Can I negotiate pricing?
pricing.answer: Volume-based pricing and custom rates are available through enterprise agreements. Contact us for a tailored proposal.

monthly.question: Can I pay monthly?
monthly.answer: Yes. Business credit accounts offer Net 15 and Net 30 terms with consolidated monthly invoicing.

pod.question: Do you provide proof of delivery?
pod.answer: Every delivery includes photo proof, digital signatures, and barcode confirmation — all accessible in your dashboard.

sameDay.question: Do you offer same-day delivery?
sameDay.answer: Yes. Same-day delivery is available across the GTA for most vehicle types, subject to availability and cutoff times.

multiStop.question: Can you handle multi-stop routes?
multiStop.answer: Yes. Multi-stop distribution is a core capability, optimized through our route planning engine.

accountManager.question: Will I have a dedicated account manager?
accountManager.answer: Enterprise accounts include a dedicated account manager. Growing business accounts can upgrade to dedicated support.

insurance.question: Are shipments insured?
insurance.answer: Standard coverage is included. Additional cargo insurance options are available for high-value shipments.

gta.question: What areas do you serve?
gta.answer: We operate across the Greater Toronto Area including Toronto, Mississauga, Brampton, Vaughan, Markham, Oakville, and surrounding areas.

onboarding.question: How long does onboarding take?
onboarding.answer: Most business accounts are operational within 3–5 business days after the initial consultation and agreement.

integrations.question: What e-commerce platforms do you support?
integrations.answer: Native integrations for Shopify and WooCommerce, plus CSV upload and REST API for any platform.

billing.question: How does billing work?
billing.answer: Choose pay-as-you-go with credit card, business credit terms (Net 15/30), or custom enterprise invoicing.

tracking.question: Is real-time tracking included?
tracking.answer: Yes. Live GPS tracking, ETA updates, and shareable tracking links are included on every delivery at no extra cost.

volume.question: Is there a minimum volume requirement?
volume.answer: No minimum volume for pay-as-you-go accounts. Enterprise agreements may have negotiated minimums with corresponding rate benefits.

support.question: What support is available?
support.answer: Email, phone, and in-app support. Enterprise accounts receive priority response times and a dedicated account manager.

custom.question: Can you build custom logistics solutions?
custom.answer: Yes. Our team designs custom routing, handling, and integration solutions for complex operational requirements.

security.question: How is my data protected?
security.answer: We use industry-standard encryption, secure cloud infrastructure, and comply with Canadian privacy regulations.
